text: To develop the students' awareness of and sensitivity to the nature of Chinese language, the essence of Chinese literature, and the value of Chinese culture; To cultivate the students' awareness of and sensitivity to the similarities and differences between the Chinese language and other languages, as well as the similarities and differences between the Chinese culture and other cultures; Main Courses Compulsory Courses: Introduction of Linguistics, Modern Chinese, Ancient Chinese, Characters, Introduction of The Second Language, Education Pedagogy, China Ancient Literature History, Writing, Reading English, Listening English, Oral English, English Newspaper and Magazine, English Extensive Reading, Writing English, and etc. Optional Courses: Pronunciation, Contemporary Vocabulary, General Physiology, History of Western Civilization, English Translation, Business English, The Second Foreign Language, Linguistics and Applied Linguistics, and etc. Students Employment Encourage students to go further study to pursue master degree; as a teacher to teach foreigners Chinese; Engage in Foreign Affairs Exchange; As secretary in international corporation; Be as an editor, journalism in news and media agency, publish departments.
